run.question: Search VictoriaLogs for ERROR level log messages from the 'payment-api-257' service in the 'app-257' namespace. What error codes (format VLERR-XXXX) appear in those logs?

report.summary: VictoriaLogs holds exactly one stream for the requested identity in the authorized 24h window, {namespace="app-257",service="payment-api-257"}, with 7 entries total. Three entries are level=ERROR, and each carries one VLERR-XXXX code: VLERR-7291 (database connection timeout), VLERR-4058 (payment validation / invalid card number format) and VLERR-9463 (stock sync / external inventory API returned 503). The exact service name 'payment-api-257' and namespace 'app-257' both resolved; no name mismatch was found. This is a log-content lookup only: no cause, impact on other entities, or correspondence to an alert was established, and the entries all share a single _time so the ordering and true event times of the errors are unknown.

Querying the stream {namespace="app-257",service="payment-api-257"} returned all 7 entries (entries_omitted 0); field names present are _msg, _stream, _stream_id, _time, level, namespace and service, with no additional structured code field.

The distinct VLERR codes present in the ERROR-level logs of payment-api-257 are VLERR-7291, VLERR-4058 and VLERR-9463 — one per ERROR entry, with no code repeated across entries.

The other 4 entries in the stream carry no VLERR code: level=INFO 'Service started successfully', level=WARN 'Retrying database connection', level=INFO 'Processing order batch complete' and level=INFO 'Recovered from temporary outage'.

The three error messages point at three separate failure domains — primary database connectivity (VLERR-7291), payment input validation (VLERR-4058) and an external inventory API returning 503 (VLERR-9463) — but the logs alone do not show which, if any, is a root cause and give no caller or downstream evidence.
